parameter.name: /* Foxioo HSL (Switch) [Legacy] Shader | 2026.08.06 */
parameter.description: Shader allows changing hue, saturation and lightness. (This is the Legacy version of the shader! It is replaced by HSL (Switch) [Rework]!)

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines what the base should be. Setting it to 0 sets the base as the texture of the object on which the effect is applied, and setting it to 1 sets this as the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Hue
parameter.description: This variable changes the color hue. (Range from 0 to 359 % INF)

parameter.name: Saturation
parameter.description: This variable changes the color saturation. (Range from 0 to 100)

parameter.name: Lightness
parameter.description: This variable changes the color lLightness. (Range from 0 to 100)
